summary: Swiggy can change its terms, policies, or services at any time, and your continued use means you accept these updates. You must provide accurate account information, keep your payment details secure, and take responsibility for any content you post. Swiggy is not responsible for menu changes, delivery delays, merchant taxes, or third-party actions once an order is delivered.

clauses.explanation_en: The company can change the terms at any time without notifying you directly.
clauses.explanation_hi: Company bina kisi direct notice ke kabhi bhi terms badal sakti hai.

clauses.quote: Your continued use of the Platform and the Services after any change is posted, constitutes your acceptance of the amended Terms of Use and other Swiggy policies.
clauses.explanation_en: Using the app after changes means you automatically agree to the new terms.
clauses.explanation_hi: App use karte rehne ka matlab hai ki aap naye rules se automatically sehmat hain.

clauses.quote: you agree to grant us a non-exclusive, worldwide, perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, sub-licensable (through multiple tiers) right to exercise the copyright, publicity, database rights or any other rights you have in your Information

clauses.quote: Swiggy reserves the right to amend, withdraw, modify, convert, suspend, or discontinue any such promotional benefits at any time without prior notice.
clauses.explanation_en: Promotional offers and benefits can be changed or canceled anytime without notice.

clauses.quote: Swiggy will not be responsible for any delay in the delivery of an Order.
clauses.explanation_en: The company is not liable if your food or order delivery is delayed.
